purpose: Edit the existing WorkRecord filter model in an in-flow panel with facet counts and searchable filter options.
behaviorProvider: Shared SearchInput, Checkbox and Accordion composed with the WorkRecord filter reducer and facet helpers.

requirements.statement: Read RecordFilterState from value and emit reducer-produced changes through onValueChange; do not independently persist the selected filters.
Compute matching record and facet counts using the existing WorkRecord filter helpers and supplied records, owners and current time. This is not an arbitrary collection query language.
Search filter option labels locally without changing selected filters; expand matching groups during search and retain the previous expansion state for the cleared query.
Keep selected owner identifiers available as removable options even when absent from the supplied owner list.
Clear all invokes the host override when supplied or the reducer reset otherwise; it is disabled when disabled or no active filter count. Close calls onClose and remains independently available.
Disable owned search and filter selection controls from disabled; arbitrary children are not automatically disabled.
Supply custom children, additionalFilterCount and onClearAll consistently when adding filters beyond RecordFilterState; update the controlled value after events.
Place the nonmodal in-flow panel in a suitable workspace, handle onClose and any resulting focus restoration, and provide valid WorkRecord data and stable owner ids.
Own pattern or component styling consumes filtering group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: WorkRecord-specific facets and count semantics; use CollectionToolbar for generic collection composition.
No fetching, routing, persistence or global focus restoration on close.
Host custom filter descendants retain their own disabled and validation responsibilities.
